title: Ordered Tree Lookup
description: Given a binary search tree and a target value, determine whether the target exists in the tree.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; all BST node values are distinct; the root is never missing.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n values in level-order representation, where -1 represents a missing node. Third line: target.
outputFormat: Print YES if the target exists, otherwise print NO.
hints: At every node, use the BST ordering property to decide whether to move left or right.

examples.explanation: 10 is present in the right subtree of 8.
7 is not present in the BST.
